status: design-only; no stage launched by this plan
purpose: Separate sandboxed offline packet builders from gate parents whose validation workers apply their own read-only sandbox.
current_source_policy: Do not modify G while its standalone reference canary is active. A later harness commit requires a fresh stratum and new registrations.

rules.source_commit: One exact actual G HEAD throughout a fresh stratum; stable-read and verify declared source bytes before every stage and compilation.
rules.environment: One owned cohort venv, one exact interpreter spelling and prefix, fixed dependency roots and one fixed shared synthetic peer/home.
rules.input_authority: Closed data-only stage configuration; no caller-supplied callable, command, source substitution or arbitrary import root.
rules.gate_parent: No inherited OS sandbox. Compile checked fixed source and install denial/audit controls in each non-sandboxed Python parent bootstrap, not just the top-level orchestrator.
rules.gate_worker: Keep the existing macOS read-only, no-network, selected-interpreter/read-only-Git sandbox unchanged.
rules.builder: Use the existing no-network/no-native OS sandbox and retain the builder's output-only write guard. Do not invoke a gate parent within this sandbox.
rules.canary: Reference registration plus persisted equal self-gate must finish before any other original packet build.
rules.proof: Exclusive fresh stage artifacts, exact input/output pins, command/source/environment/origin evidence and observed-process cleanup evidence. A failed stage remains a failure and stops automatic progression.
rules.reuse: No cache, comparison-case reuse or old failed-cohort acceptance. A later separately bounded stage consumes predecessor artifacts only through pinned, verified stage outputs.
rules.deadline: Each active job is bounded by at most 14400 active seconds; a native quiet-window pause does not authorize a new stage.
rules.concurrency: One stage at a time; shared machine worker budget remains at most two.
rules.side_effects: No native binary, model/provider, real probe, capture, reservation, network or publication. Never move G/N HEAD for controls. Private same-tree HEAD moves are confined to the owned source export and always restored.
